info.title: Rythu API
info.description: Honest weather + farming advice for Telangana farmers.

get.summary: Forecast and farming reads for a point

parameters.name: lat

schema.description: Decimal degrees. Give lat and lon together, or neither (defaults to Bhupalpally). Telangana + border only.
schema.title: Lat

parameters.description: Decimal degrees. Give lat and lon together, or neither (defaults to Bhupalpally). Telangana + border only.

parameters.name: crop

schema.description: One of: cotton, paddy, red_gram, maize, chilli. Omit for crop-independent reads only.
schema.title: Crop

parameters.description: One of: cotton, paddy, red_gram, maize, chilli. Omit for crop-independent reads only.

parameters.name: water

schema.description: One of: canal_lift, tank, borewell, rainfed. Default rainfed.
schema.title: Water

parameters.description: One of: canal_lift, tank, borewell, rainfed. Default rainfed.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id

schema.description: Optional correlation id, echoed back if safe ([A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}).
schema.title: X-Request-Id

parameters.description: Optional correlation id, echoed back if safe ([A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}).

200.description: Forecast + farming reads, or an honest degraded answer.

get.summary: Find a village by name (Telangana + border)

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Village, town or mandal name (2-60 characters). Search on submit, not per keystroke.
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Village, town or mandal name (2-60 characters). Search on submit, not per keystroke.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id

schema.description: Optional correlation id, echoed back if safe ([A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}).
schema.title: X-Request-Id

parameters.description: Optional correlation id, echoed back if safe ([A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}).

400.description: Query missing, too short or too long.

503.description: No geocoding source could be asked (code=upstream_unavailable).

get.summary: My-Field crop calendar from a sowing or transplanting date

parameters.name: crop

schema.description: One of: cotton, paddy, red_gram, maize, chilli. Omit for crop-independent reads only.
schema.title: Crop

parameters.description: One of: cotton, paddy, red_gram, maize, chilli. Omit for crop-independent reads only.

parameters.name: date

schema.description: YYYY-MM-DD: sowing date, or transplanting date for paddy and chilli.
schema.title: Date

parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD: sowing date, or transplanting date for paddy and chilli.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id

schema.description: Optional correlation id, echoed back if safe ([A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}).
schema.title: X-Request-Id

parameters.description: Optional correlation id, echoed back if safe ([A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}).

200.description: The crop's tasks, dated (stage-based ones last).

400.description: Unknown crop, or a malformed / out-of-range date.

429.description: Too many new devices this hour.

post.summary: Trade the device secret for a one-hour token

get.summary: The profile saved by this device

400.description: Malformed body, or a village outside coverage (code=outside_coverage).

412.description: The saved profile changed since you read it (or one already exists).

428.description: Send If-Match: <etag> to update, or If-None-Match: * to create.

400.description: Not a browser push service, malformed keys, or too many phones.

delete.summary: Delete everything stored for this user

reference.description: Which date the offsets count from: sowing or transplanting.

CalendarOut.title: CalendarOut
CalendarOut.description: ``GET /v1/calendar`` 200 body: the crop's tasks dated from the farmer's reference date.

start.title: Start
start.description: YYYY-MM-DD; null = stage-based (see stage_*), no reliable date.

end.title: End
end.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive; null with a start = from then on.

source.title: Source
source.description: The official source this task restates.

needs_verification.title: Needs Verification
needs_verification.description: Show the 'confirm with your AEO / Soil Health Card' note.

returned.description: The model grid point that answered.

snap_distance_km.title: Snap Distance Km
snap_distance_km.description: Distance from the farmer's pin to the grid point.

Crop.title: Crop
Crop.description: The pilot crop set for Bhupalpally Kharif.

date.title: Date
date.description: Local calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Never earlier than today.

device_secret.title: Device Secret
device_secret.description: 256-bit secret. Keep on the device; trade it for tokens.

DeviceCredentialsOut.title: DeviceCredentialsOut
DeviceCredentialsOut.description: ``POST /v1/devices`` 201 body. Shown once: the server keeps only a digest of the secret.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: 4xx/5xx body. ``code`` is stable and machine-readable; ``error`` is for humans/logs.

FarmAction.title: FarmAction
FarmAction.description: The farm operation a rule advises on. Lets the UI group reads by activity.

severity.description: UI emphasis, NOT a certainty claim.

headline_te.title: Headline Te
headline_te.description: Empty string = fall back to the English field.

id.title: Id
id.description: Chosen by the phone; stable across edits.

reference_date.title: Reference Date
reference_date.description: Sowing date, or transplanting date for paddy and chilli (see /v1/calendar). Not more than 400 days ago or 60 days ahead.

FieldIO.title: FieldIO
FieldIO.description: One of the farmer's fields (My-Field): what grows there and since when.

GeocodeResults.title: GeocodeResults
GeocodeResults.description: ``GET /v1/geocode`` 200 body: places inside Rythu's coverage, best match first (may be empty).

name_te.title: Name Te
name_te.description: Telugu name when OpenStreetMap has one; else null.

ProfileIn.title: ProfileIn
ProfileIn.description: What the phone saves on the server — only what alerts and the crop calendar need.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: Server time of the last write, ISO-8601.

public_key.title: Public Key
public_key.description: VAPID application server key (base64url, 65-byte P-256 point) for PushManager.subscribe().

PushSubscriptionIn.title: PushSubscriptionIn
PushSubscriptionIn.description: A browser PushSubscription (endpoint + keys). Only real browser push services are accepted.

show_confidence_rating.title: Show Confidence Rating
show_confidence_rating.description: Always false: a deterministic model has no honest confidence to show.

source_stamp_en.title: Source Stamp En
source_stamp_en.description: Source, resolution and data age, e.g. 'updated 8 min ago'.

is_offline_cache.title: Is Offline Cache
is_offline_cache.description: True when serving a saved copy because upstream is down.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: ISO-8601; ask for a new token a little before this.

Severity.title: Severity
Severity.description: UI emphasis for a read — NOT a certainty claim about the weather.

WMOCategory.title: WMOCategory
WMOCategory.description: Coarse bucket for a WMO ``weather_code`` (icon/colour grouping + storm guard).

WaterSource.title: WaterSource
WaterSource.description: Farmer's water source — the #1 crop-advice input. Scopes rules as data, not code.

hourly_rain.title: Hourly Rain
hourly_rain.description: From the current hour forward, up to 48 rows.

WeatherContract.title: WeatherContract
WeatherContract.description: ``GET /v1/weather`` 200 body — a forecast, or an honest degraded answer (``degraded: true``).
